item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President presently establishes an executive-branch policy of active Federal-land management; it guides later agency action but itself changes no legal rights or status.","evidence":"It is the policy of the United States to protect people, communities, and watersheds"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretaries must implement management policies and later develop departmental goals and implementation plans; these are planning, coordination, and prioritization duties without a dictated legal consequence.","evidence":"the Secretaries shall each develop goals and implementation plans for wildfire prevention activities and programs in their respective departments"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Interior Secretary must review budget justifications and consider possible 2019 operational objectives, expressly retaining feasibility and appropriateness discretion; any implementation occurs later.","evidence":"shall review the Secretary's 2019 budget justifications and give all due consideration to establishing the following objectives"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Agriculture Secretary and both Secretaries must review, consider objectives, and develop performance metrics; these are discretionary program-management and measurement tasks rather than specified legal outcomes.","evidence":"The Secretaries shall also refine and develop performance metrics"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretaries must conduct reviews, coordination, prioritization, strategy development, procedural streamlining, and discretionary program implementation; later projects, agreements, and contracts remain subject to agency administration and applicable law rather than a presently imposed legal consequence.","evidence":"the Secretaries shall jointly develop, by December 31, 2020, a strategy"}]}
